Today, it has evolved into a cherished green symbol of Hanoi, a beloved sanctuary that seamlessly blends historical significance with modern-day tranquility. The garden is situated in the Ba Dinh district, a historic area close to the revered Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum, which adds to its cultural importance.
